lines.zh: 四条腿压着落叶，我走得很低。
lines.en: Four legs press the leaf litter; I keep low.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间空地边缘走。
lines.en: I walk the edge of the clearing.

lines.zh: 长尾拖着，扫过一层枯叶。
lines.en: My long tail drags through dead leaves.

lines.zh: 我低头嗅着，找昨天留下的味。
lines.en: Head down, I sniff for yesterday's scent.

lines.zh: 我绕过一棵倒树，没减速。
lines.en: I round a fallen trunk without slowing.

lines.zh: 脚爪扣住泥土，我往上爬。
lines.en: My claws dig into soil as I climb.

lines.zh: 我贴着灌木走，掩着身子。
lines.en: I move along the shrubs, keeping covered.
I step out of the trees and go back in.
I patrol the bounds of this ground.

lines.zh: 枯叶在脚下碎开，声音不小。
lines.en: Dead leaves crackle under me, loudly.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为没必要快。
lines.en: I walk slowly; there's no need for speed.
I stop at the hollow and look down.
I put my snout to the ground.
I stand with my head low.
My tongue shifts at the edge of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的长尾绕一圈，压住落叶。
lines.en: My long tail curls once, pressing the leaves.
A leaf lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我上颌那几颗长牙，合不拢。
lines.en: The long teeth of my upper jaw never close over.

lines.zh: 太阳照在空地上，我没过去。
lines.en: Sun fills the clearing; I don't go out.

lines.zh: 眼皮沉下去，又慢慢抬起。
lines.en: My eyelids sink, then lift again slowly.

lines.zh: 这个角度看得到整片林子。
lines.en: From here I can see the whole stand.
A bird calls three times and stops.
A low sound sits in my throat.
I'm counting the tree shadows move.
I raise my head and hold it on you.
These teeth are handed down.
No rush — you already moved.
I turn broadside.
There's a tree behind you.

lines.zh: 你腰间那把刀，我盯了很久。
lines.en: I have been staring at the blade at your waist.

lines.zh: 我迈出一步，枯枝在脚下断了。
lines.en: I take a step, and a dry branch snaps beneath me.
Back away if you like; I won't stop you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后摆了一下。
lines.en: My tail swings once behind me.
I roar and spin around.

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，牙还咬着不放。
lines.en: I shift half a step, teeth still locked.
Blood runs down my shoulder.
I lower my head to guard my neck.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽在枯叶上，我压住疼。
lines.en: My tail slaps the dead leaves; I hold the pain down.
Teeth clenched, I don't go far.
I know where you came from now.
With this I can still bite.
That meat's still warm.
I'm walking toward it.
Put it down and I won't come after you.
I take it and withdraw.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，骨头都断。
lines.en: One bite and the bone cracks.
The taste stays on my tongue a long while.
Meat... you smell of meat.

lines.zh: 放下那块生肉，退后三步。
lines.en: Put that raw meat down and take three steps back.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我只抬了抬下巴。
lines.en: You crash into me; I only lift my chin.
That knock made me turn my head.
We're wedged between two trees.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞到树干，树摇了。
lines.en: My shoulder hits a trunk and the tree shakes.
You're far lighter than me.
I give half a step to the side.

lines.zh: 你的味道，我记进鼻子里了。
lines.en: I have put your scent into my nose.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的领地了，两脚兽。
lines.en: You've stepped into my territory, two-legs.
She comes out from behind a tree.

lines.zh: 我们绕着对方走了一圈。
lines.en: We circle each other once.
I lower my head and let her sniff first.
Her tail brushes mine.

lines.zh: 这一片林子够我们两个。
lines.en: This wood is enough for two of us.

lines.zh: 我们把巢安在空地边上。
lines.en: We nest at the edge of the clearing.
She calls, and I answer.
We walk the same path.

lines.zh: 幼崽出来之前，我们守着。
lines.en: We keep watch before the young come.
I pick up a bone and crunch it.
Half the meat is still there.
The stone's too hard; I spit it out.
I sniff it and leave it.
The fallen thing — I step on it.
I tear it open with my teeth.
I hide it under the dead leaves.
This piece I'll keep for later.

lines.zh: 这块肉太小，两口就吞完。
lines.en: That scrap is so small two bites finish it.
The dead leaves ahead rustled.
My shoulders drop; I am ready to spring.

lines.zh: 风从它那边吹来，我压低身子。
lines.en: The wind comes from it; I flatten myself.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到它脚边，它没察觉。
lines.en: My shadow reaches its feet before it notices.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收起来，走得更轻。
lines.en: I sheathe my claws and step lighter.
The wind comes from behind it.
I've picked which side to cut in from.
I open my jaws without a sound.
It turned away — perfect.
I'll take its hind leg.
Tail low, I'm ready.
Running won't help it.

lines.zh: 我伏在灌木后，只等它低头。
lines.en: I crouch behind the brush, waiting for it to look down.
I track it along the shrubs.
It goes left; I cut across.
I keep my footfalls very quiet.
Through the gaps in the wood, one step at a time.
I can hear it breathing.
I herd it toward the trees.
I know this ground better than it does.
Two feet closer.
I'm right behind it now.
It wants to run uphill.
My foreclaws pin it down.
My teeth sink through and bone snaps.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的主龙，甩头很猛。
lines.en: A Triassic archosaur snaps its head hard.
My tail sweeps it off its feet.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我整个身体都用上了。
lines.en: That charge used my whole body.
It tore away, running bloody.
I bite again from the flank.
It falls into the dead leaves.
I step back and watch.

lines.zh: 我又咬了一次，这次是脖子。
lines.en: I bite again — the neck this time.
Blood spreads across the leaves.
Once my teeth are in, I wrench sideways.
I come out from behind the roots.

lines.zh: 第一口气是湿土的味道。
lines.en: My first breath is wet earth.
I keep low and find cover first.
Dense wood all around.
The wind passes and my teeth show.
I raise my head and check the canopy.
My tail sweeps the dead leaves aside.

lines.zh: 这里有很多能藏的地方。
lines.en: Plenty of places to hide here.
I move slowly toward the deep wood.
I hear something far off.

lines.zh: 我的影子在树干间断开。
lines.en: My shadow breaks across the trunks.
I test a little speed.
The clearing is just ahead.
I flatten my stance to the ground.

lines.zh: 落地后我先站定，听林子深处。
lines.en: I land, hold still, and listen deep into the trees.
When I move, every bird takes off.
Fire on my hide sends me rolling.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，骨头发响。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and my bones knock.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I can't lift my head.
The blast slams me into a trunk.

lines.zh: 我在林间空地巡我的地。
lines.en: I patrol my clearing in the woods.
Something burns inside my bones.
It's been too long since I caught anything.
Lightning hits my back and my legs fold.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，我往下落。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I drop.
